$comment: Managed by `nr` (see .config/nix/nr-pins). A pin freezes a flake input at the last rev that built, because that input's branch head would force a package to be built from source whose own tests fail here. `nr --update` probes each pin against its branch head before updating and drops it as soon as a substituter carries the package again. flake.nix's pin block is generated from this file — edit this file, not the block.

pins.reason: the stable bump changed python3.13-tokenizers, so it stopped substituting; building it pulls its test deps (datasets, pyarrow, arrow-cpp) and thrift 0.24.0's C++ tests do not compile against libcxx 21 (a Catch2 static_assert plus an assembler error).

it moved CPython to 3.12.15, which backports gh-156793 / CVE-2026-19553 (SSLContext.wrap_bio() rejects server_hostname in server mode); anyio 4.14.2's own pytest suite fails on it. Arrives through hermes-agent's python env.
